what_this_is: PROPOSED speedrun::topic:: tags for an Anki deck, matched against the published USMLE outline. Nothing has been applied to any collection; applying is a separate explicit step.
known_limitations: The 11 discipline-axis topics (Pathology, Microbiology, Pharmacology, ...) carry a one-word name and NO examples in outline.json, so there is no vocabulary to match against and this matcher proposes zero discipline tags. coverage.py will therefore report the whole discipline axis as uncovered. That is a fact about the outline's shape and about keyword matching, NOT evidence that the deck contains no microbiology.

Matching is lexical. A card that teaches a topic without naming it -- mechanism-only cards on Gram staining, toxin biochemistry, plasmid transfer, antibiotic targets -- cannot be matched, because the outline gives those no vocabulary either. Those notes are reported as NONE.
The outline states its examples are 'just examples', so a topic's vocabulary is incomplete by construction. Absence of a hit is weak evidence of absence of coverage.
Head-noun evidence ('endocarditis' from 'bacterial endocarditis') throws the modifier away and can only support a proposal, never establish one.
Nothing here has been applied to any collection. Applying is a separate, explicit step.
